description: Extension to rear to enclose existing rear balcony including replacement of non-original rear windows with matching timber casement French doors, new cast iron railing to master bedroom window creating a Juliet balcony, new entrance into master bedroom from main corridor making good existing opening and adding closet to rear bathroom accessible via main corridor. Lowering of threshold between back room and terrace including replacement of non-original rear windows with matching timber casement French doors, enlarging opening of window in guest bedroom, and removing existing step to make bedroom and terrace flush to same level. Replacement of existing fenestration to facade including Histoglass to replace existing glass within windows of main elevation, retaining existing timber frames. Addition of air conditioning cooling system including new heat pump units be concealed within existing modern corridor ceiling void, outdoor condenser unit to modern terrace, located within  sheltered position adjacent to existing return wall, sheltering units from surrounding views.***WITHDRAWN***
